entities.summary: Robert Joseph Cunningham is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as bishop of the Diocese of Syracuse in Upstate New York from 2009 to 2019. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Ogdensburg in Northern New York from 2004 to 2009.
